description: The same all-green chain that mechanically consumes, but driven under origin_mode=synthetic instead of drill. The chain succeeds (structure demonstrated, proposal packet emitted) yet the outcome is NOT operational: a synthetic-origin consume is a DemonstratedConsumed that the spend wall (confer_operational_effect) refuses by type. The launch demo's 'synthetic evidence fenced' beat -- proof that running the public demo cannot mint spendable/operational receipts. The override-origin_mode key tells the harness to rebuild the all-green finding with this origin.
